answer: The plume curve is published each epoch, nadir records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 29 admissions. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, thus the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and each identity burns the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the signal rate. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
